Implementation.criterion_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation
Implementation.source_section: 1. Evaluation > 3. Quality and efficiency of the implementation (Score 3)

compliance_checklist.description: Scope of the application: based on the information provided, the application must correspond, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it was submitted ('in scope'). Partial out-of-scope must be reflected in scoring.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions > Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding: a third-country participant/international organisation not listed in the General Annex may exceptionally receive funding only if participation is essential for carrying out the project.
Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): assess whether the proposal involves hESC and, if so, whether their use is necessary to achieve the scientific objectives.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions > Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: assess whether the proposal involves the use of human embryos and how they will be used.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions > Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: the proposal must not include human reproductive cloning, heritable genetic modification of human beings, creation of human embryos solely for research or stem cell procurement, or destruction of human embryos.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions > Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: the proposed activities must have an exclusive focus on civil applications; activities for military application or purposes cannot be funded.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions > Exclusive focus on civil applications
